capability.name: single-relation cause → visible effect (single-relation/1)
capability.nature: productisation of Semantic Film Director 1.0's successful part (dev/c11 semantic-director.js + SemanticStage.tsx, reused) — NOT a new visual invention; Director 2.0's progressive build / reads / new verbs / camera moves NOT carried
capability.claimSafety: from Director 2.0 only the checks that block a real misread, made stricter: planned / hypothetical / negation / question cues in the evidence → no staging (quote card); evidence / card text / labels never from a notAsserted part (a planned or quoted part may be shown WITH its frame, e.g. 'someone proposed …'); rejected-premise cue must be resolved (no cueCheck override); speaker shown on quoted cards. Fixtures B05, B17, C24.
capability.calibratedOnData: first strict version refused Director 1.0's best contracts (C05 B 83, C26 B 100): person pronouns, motives ('want to'), rhetorical questions and 'not' inside a resolved contrast were narrowed before any rating; the B05 / B17 / C24 protections still hold (tests)
capability.coverage: cycle 11 + 12 Director 1.0 contracts in scope (A / B / H): 53 drawn, 13 refused (mostly unresolved contrast / negation cues an author fixes by listing the not-asserted part; B05 refused as intended), 14 out of scope (C–G)
